subject: Video Testimonial: Filming Plan, Script & Release Form
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: evan.shaw@bedrocklabs.com; tess@bedrocklabs.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai; stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Video Testimonial: Filming Plan, Script & Release Form

Hi Evan / Tess,

Thanks again for agreeing to do a short customer video about how Bedrock Labs uses Redwood Inference. We want to keep this low-effort for your team — aim for a ~2–3 minute on-camera piece (no scripted lines required), plus a few B-roll shots if you're able.

Attached are three things to kick off: a short proposed script (which we treat as talking points), a suggested shot list for remote filming, and our standard release form. High-level plan:
- Goal: 2–3 minute testimonial + 15–30s quote clip for ads
- Recording options: remote interview over a simple Zoom-recorded camera setup OR in-person at your SF office (we can travel).
- Timeline: record by Aug 10 -> edit -> deliver final cut by Aug 21.

Would you prefer Zoom or an on-site shoot? Also: any required legal language or brand approvals from Bedrock we should factor in?

If Zoom: we’ll send a call invite with a quick tech checklist; we'll capture separate audio if possible. If in-person: we’ll propose a 3-hour window, and we’ll bring a small two-person crew (DP + producer).

Thanks — we're excited to feature Bedrock Labs.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0189

Attachments: proposed_script_laura_v2.docx; bedrock_shot_list_v1.docx; redwood_testimonial_release_v3.pdf

From: evan.shaw@bedrocklabs.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Video Testimonial: Filming Plan, Script & Release Form

Laura — thanks, this looks great. Tess and I reviewed the materials. A few quick notes:
- We prefer Zoom for speed (our exec travel is heavy in August).
- Timing: Aug 9–11 works best for our leadership team (we can do morning PST).
- Legal: our comms team asked for a 72-hour review period on the final cut and one round of minor edits. That’s fine?

Also, Tess is the internal owner on our side — copying her. She’ll coordinate availability.

Appreciate the clear plan.

Best,
Evan
Head of Product, Bedrock Labs

Hi Laura — quick logistics note from our side:
- We’ll confirm a 30–45 minute Zoom slot for an interview; Evan will be the speaker.
- For B-roll, we can share short screen recordings of the Redwood dashboard flow and a couple of product screenshots — will upload to the Drive link you shared.
- Legal review: I’ll route the release form to our legal (CC’d: julia.legal@bedrocklabs.com). They requested a minor change to Section 4 (usage rights) to add a clause restricting use in paid media for 12 months unless we both agree.

Is that something Redwood can accept? If not, we can propose adding a short amendment and sign off.

Thanks,
Tess Hargrove
Director, Customer Success
Bedrock Labs

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai; stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai; aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Video Testimonial: Filming Plan, Script & Release Form

Folks — looping in legal ops (Aditya) and sales (Stephanie) to confirm the usage clause. We want to be accommodating but keep marketing flexibility.

Proposed compromise: accept the 12-month restriction for paid media but request an exception permitting product website and case study use immediately. If Bedrock agrees, we can add an amendment to the release form and proceed.

Also, Laura — for the Zoom shoot: I recommend we capture
- a short intro question set (3–4 prompts)
- one demo segment (screen share)
- closing quote prompt for the 15–30s clip

I can run the tech check on the day and own the recording deliverable.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: tess@bedrocklabs.com; laura_bennett@redwood.ai; monica_patel@redwood.ai; stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Video Testimonial: Filming Plan, Script & Release Form

Tess / Bedrock legal — thanks for flagging. We can accept the 12-month restriction on paid media with one condition: please confirm in writing that Redwood retains the right to use the footage for product pages, case studies, and organic social channels immediately. I’ve attached an amendment template to the Drive folder — if that works we’ll produce an updated PDF for signature via DocuSign.

Also noting: please confirm the person who will sign on Bedrock’s legal side and whether you prefer DocuSign or countersign by email.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Legal Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_testimonial_release_v3.pdf (amendment template in Drive)

Next steps I’ll take today:
- Finalize the interview prompts and share the confirmed script (talking points) by EOD (attached: proposed_script_laura_v2.docx).
- Upload the shot list and a small checklist for your comms team (already in Drive).
- Aditya to prepare the amendment PDF and send via DocuSign.

Tess — can you confirm that Bedrock legal will sign via DocuSign and who the signer is (name + title)? Evan — please confirm the Aug 10 09:30 PT slot and whether you'd like any internal slides/screens prepped for the demo segment.

Looking forward — we’ll keep this tight and painless.

Best,
Laura
